import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

SRC = "unpacked/word/document.xml"
W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"

for prefix, uri in [
    ("ve", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"),
    ("o", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office"),
    ("r", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"),
    ("v", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml"),
    ("wp", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing"),
    ("w10", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:word"),
    ("w", W),
]:
    ET.register_namespace(prefix, uri)

tree = ET.parse(SRC)
root = tree.getroot()
body = root.find(f"{{{W}}}body")
sectPr = body.find(f"{{{W}}}sectPr")

def mk_par(text):
    p = ET.SubElement(body, f"{{{W}}}p")
    pPr = ET.SubElement(p, f"{{{W}}}pPr")
    r = ET.SubElement(p, f"{{{W}}}r")
    rPr = ET.SubElement(r, f"{{{W}}}rPr")
    rFonts = ET.SubElement(rPr, f"{{{W}}}rFonts")
    rFonts.set(f"{{{W}}}ascii", "Helvetica Light")
    rFonts.set(f"{{{W}}}hAnsi", "Helvetica Light")
    rFonts.set(f"{{{W}}}cs", "Helvetica Light")
    sz = ET.SubElement(rPr, f"{{{W}}}sz")
    sz.set(f"{{{W}}}val", "24")
    szCs = ET.SubElement(rPr, f"{{{W}}}sz-cs")
    szCs.set(f"{{{W}}}val", "24")
    t = ET.SubElement(r, f"{{{W}}}t")
    t.set("{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}space", "preserve")
    t.text = text
    return p

# Insert paragraphs before sectPr (sectPr must remain last child of body)
paras = []
paras.append(mk_par("RECOMMENDATIONS"))
paras.append(mk_par(""))
paras.append(mk_par(
    "Based on the fourth quarter results and the Q1 2025 outlook, management "
    "recommends the following actions:"))
paras.append(mk_par("\u2022 Accelerate investment in Cloud Services, which delivered the strongest "
                    "growth (22.8% YoY) and the highest margin expansion."))
paras.append(mk_par("\u2022 Expand international market presence in Q1 2025, prioritizing regions "
                    "with the lowest customer acquisition costs."))
paras.append(mk_par("\u2022 Maintain research and development spending at or above 12% of revenue "
                    "to sustain the product pipeline."))
paras.append(mk_par("\u2022 Strengthen supply chain hedging to mitigate the currency and logistics "
                    "risks identified in the risk assessment."))
paras.append(mk_par(""))
paras.append(mk_par(
    "These recommendations are designed to sustain revenue growth in the 10-13% range "
    "while preserving operating margins above 22%."))

idx = list(body).index(sectPr)
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    body.insert(idx + i, p)

tree.write(SRC, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)
print("added", len(paras), "paragraphs")
